recipes.name: Roast Beef inspired by Attack on Titan
ingredients: ~4 lb boneless dry aged ribeye roast
instructions: Cut a crosshatch pattern into the fat cap of the roast. - ~4 lb boneless dry aged ribeye roast
Coat the beef in a generous layer of kosher salt, then refrigerate the beef uncovered overnight. - kosher salt as needed - freshly ground pepper as needed - ~4 lb boneless dry aged ribeye roast
The next day, preheat the oven to 325 °F with convection.
Transfer the beef to a cooling rack placed inside of a rimmed baking sheet. - ~4 lb boneless dry aged ribeye roast
Insert a probe thermometer into the thickest part of the beef. - ~4 lb boneless dry aged ribeye roast

Roast the beef for 1-2 hours, or until the internal temperature reaches 115 °F. Then remove the roast from the oven and brush it down with the rendered beef tallow from the bottom of the tray. - ~4 lb boneless dry aged ribeye roast
Increase the heat to 500 °F and cook for 5-10 minutes or until the beef is well-browned.
Once the beef is done, remove it from the oven and allow it to rest for 20-30 minutes before slicing. - ~4 lb boneless dry aged ribeye roast
